segments.text: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
“If someone ventures to talk with you, will you be grieved? But who can withhold himself from speaking?
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Behold, you have instructed many, you have strengthened the weak hands.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Your words have supported him who was falling, you have made the feeble knees firm.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: But now it has come to you, and you faint. It touches you, and you are troubled.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Isn’t your piety your confidence? Isn’t the integrity of your ways your hope?
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: “Remember, now, who ever perished, being innocent? Or where were the upright cut off?
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity and sow trouble, reap the same.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: By the breath of God they perish. By the blast of his anger are they consumed.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion,
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: The old lion perishes for lack of prey. The cubs of the lioness are scattered abroad.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: “Now a thing was secretly brought to me. My ear received a whisper of it.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: In thoughts from the visions of the night, when deep sleep falls on men,
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: fear came on me, and trembling, which made all my bones shake.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Then a spirit passed before my face. The hair of my flesh stood up.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: It stood still, but I couldn’t discern its appearance. A form was before my eyes.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Silence, then I heard a voice, saying,
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: ‘Shall mortal man be more just than God? Shall a man be more pure than his Maker?
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Behold, he puts no trust in his servants. He charges his angels with error.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: How much more those who dwell in houses of clay, whose foundation is in the dust,
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: who are crushed before the moth!
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Between morning and evening they are destroyed. They perish forever without any regarding it.
segments.speaker: Eliphaz

segments.text: Isn’t their tent cord plucked up within them? They die, and that without wisdom.’
segments.speaker: Eliphaz
